key_insight: AI agents discovered quantum programs with formally verified correctness and cost, achieving substantial improvements over prior baselines.
engineering_relevance: Proof-guided program discovery could reduce quantum resource requirements for scientific applications beyond what classical simulation can feasibly validate.
method: Build a quantum program library in the Lean theorem prover.
Use language-model agents to synthesize programs against formal specifications and verify correctness and cost.
Coordinate agent teams through shared wikis and organized conferences.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports improvements of up to 1.4× for parallel search, 290× for quantum arithmetic, and 11×, 8× and 2.5× for simulations relevant to fusion, photochemistry and drug metabolism, respectively.
watch_item: Formal guarantees depend on the specifications and cost model; reported improvements do not by themselves establish speedups on physical quantum hardware.
paper_title: Discovering formally verified quantum programs with AI
